changelog:
Frame Builder skill initial release.

- Launch builder and product coins with compound funding and gas-free deployment on Frame (Base chain).
- Create EVM wallets, upload images/metadata to IPFS, and monitor token status.
- Claim vesting rewards (10% over 12 months) and 50% trading fees directly.
- Integrates with OpenClaw heartbeat for automated monitoring and tracking.
- Detailed documentation on wallet setup, launches, claims, and auto-updating.
summary: Build in public with vibe raising. Launch your builder coin and ship products under it — every launch compounds funding and traction back to your builder. Claim vesting rewards and trading fees. Gas-free on Frame (Base).
